name: HolyMind — Grand Fireworks / Real Recordings
request: Much bigger alternating large/small fireworks, with realistic high-toned firework sound instead of the disliked synthetic cue.

visual.shape: Pixel-neon radial, fan, diamond, needle and crystal; wider overhead composition and longer streaks, not just increased glow
visual.placement: Earlier stable signature arrival creates room above the name; no new pin or spacer. Canvas and radii remain bounded on 320–1440 px and short landscape.
visual.reverse: The same fixed-seed identities and paths retrace into the full stop. Paused identical frames are not repainted.

audio.basis: Real field recordings, not generated noise or oscillators
audio.license: CC0 1.0 as listed by each author
audio.source_representation: Author-published HQ MP3 previews, self-hosted with source URLs and SHA256 hashes, not original lossless WAVs
audio.focus: Recorded high rocket whistles, bright impact cracks and irregular sparkling crackle. Low synthetic thud and embedded piano from the old firework cue lane are removed.
audio.processing: Selected excerpts, high/low-pass EQ, bounded recorded-transient compression, mild whistle-rate variation, level balancing and finite fades. No AI audio model.
audio.return: Re-enveloped reversed recorded excerpts for artistic inward recall; not a recording of a physical inward explosion.
audio.loading: One same-origin PCM bank plus manifest, prepared before interaction without creating AudioContext. No on-scroll waveform synthesis; missing/late files remain silent without replaying stale cues or old synth fallback.
audio.preview_note: Illustrative five launch/burst pairs mixed at production bus/default-master levels. Actual site timing follows the scroll, not this file.

audio_measurements.description: Energy-weighted Hann-windowed FFT of edited PCM, not a perceptual listening score.

limitations.note: Browser-emulated touch, waveform and stability checks do not replace listening or frame-rate testing on the user’s actual phone.
